name: Southern Way 1000
description: Seven Great Rides connected into one epic lower South Island loop.
text1:
Launched in June 2026, the Southern Way 1000 is a new figure-eight bikepacking route through Otago and Southland. It links seven Great Rides: the Queenstown Trails, Around the Mountains, Roxburgh Gorge, Clutha Gold, Otago Central Rail Trail, Lake Dunstan Trail and the new Kawarau Gorge Trail.
The classic circuit is around 910 km, while recommended side trips bring the full journey close to 1,000 km. More than 80% is unpaved, including over 600 km of purpose-built cycle trail, with quiet rural and backcountry roads.

An excellent 7 stage itinerary has been put together on the [Southern Way 1000 website](https://southernway.nz/southern-way-1000) and is well worth checking out.
text2: The route is divided into seven stages and normally takes one to two weeks, although each stage or Great Ride also works as a shorter trip. You can start anywhere, but Queenstown and Dunedin are the easiest access points, with airports, shops and transport options.
text3: Most of the riding is straightforward. The exception is the remote Grade 4 Nevis Road stage, which requires backcountry experience, suitable equipment and favourable weather.
